AMENDMENT NO. 3 TO SCHEDULE TO
Tender Offer Statement under Section 13(e)(1) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
NORTHBANK ENERGY LTD.

This Amendment No. 3 amends and supplements the Tender Offer Statement on Schedule TO originally filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on August 14, 2026, relating to the offer by Northbank Energy Ltd. to purchase for cash up to 3,000,000 of its common shares at a price of $6.10 per share.

The Offer expires at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on October 9, 2026.

Amendment to the Odd Lot Provisions. The section of the Offer to Purchase captioned “Odd Lots” is hereby deleted in its entirety. Accordingly, the odd lot priority previously described in the Offer to Purchase is hereby eliminated, and shareholders who own fewer than 100 common shares will no longer have their shares accepted for purchase before proration. All Shares validly tendered and not withdrawn will be subject to proration on the same basis, regardless of the number of Shares owned by the tendering shareholder.

Except as amended by this Amendment, the terms of the Offer to Purchase remain in full force and effect.
